description: minimumReleaseAge and ignorePaths: Renovate is this repo's only version bot since 2026-10-16 (Dependabot version updates removed; security alerts stay on). minimumReleaseAge keeps the 7-day hold Dependabot's cooldown gave, because a freshly published release is the prime window for a compromised package. ignorePaths is config:recommended's list minus **/examples/**, so the examples/* apps Dependabot covered stay covered. The root package.json override vitepress > vite (^6) with its nested esbuild (^0.25) is deliberate: vitepress 1 breaks on vite 8 (every page 404s its lean chunk, #218), and vite 6 needs esbuild 0.25, which the root's esbuild ^0.28 security floor would otherwise replace. The packageRules below keep Renovate from bumping either pin, which npm would hide: it ignores a changed override range while the lockfile still satisfies the tree, so a bump only bites at the next lock regeneration. The root devDependencies on vite, esbuild and @vitejs/plugin-vue are what keep vitepress's vite 6 and esbuild 0.25 nested: without vite a fresh lock hoists vite 6 to the root, beside the examples' @vitejs/plugin-react, which needs vite 8 (#244); without esbuild it hoists 0.25 under tsx and the root vite; without plugin-vue npm leaks the override onto the examples' plugin-vue and fails to resolve. The tsx > esbuild override stops the same leak through vite 6's optional tsx peer, which would otherwise run tsx on esbuild 0.25. Drop both overrides, those two rules and the three root devDependencies once vitepress moves to a vite that accepts esbuild 0.28.

packageRules.description: Hold vitepress's vite override to 6.x, see the description at the top
Hold vitepress's nested esbuild override to 0.25.x. matchCurrentValue spares the top-level esbuild override, which stays free to move.

Hold @types/node to the Node major CI runs (26.x in .github/workflows/main.yml). Types for a newer major describe APIs the runtime lacks, so code type-checks and then fails at run time. Raise this bound in the same commit that moves CI's node-version.
